readings.sourceText: In the KJV of Zechariah 9:14 the Lord God shall go with whirlwinds of the south. Brenton’s Greek has πορεύσεται ἐν σάλῳ ἀπειλῆς αὐτοῦ, “he shall go in the tossing of his threat”, with no mention of the south.

records.title: “They shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign” — Brenton’s Greek prints “holy stones are rolled upon his land”

readings.label: Reading the stated claims
readings.summary: In the KJV of Zechariah 9:16 the people shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon the Lord’s land.
readings.sourceText: In the KJV of Zechariah 9:16 the people shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon the Lord’s land. Brenton’s Greek has διότι λίθοι ἅγιοι κυλίονται ἐπὶ γῆς αὐτοῦ, “for holy stones are rolling on his land”.
